name: aqua-orb-underwater
prompt: Tall portrait shot from deep inside a sunny lagoon, the camera low and angled up toward the light through water so clean and turquoise it looks freshly rendered. High overhead the surface is a shimmering silver-white ceiling, and broad shafts of sunshine slant down through it in long diagonal bands that soften and fade before they reach the pale sand. Suspended dead centre, a flawless clear glass sphere about the size of a beach ball hangs weightless: a crisp crescent of white light gleams along its top rim, a gentle cyan glow wraps its underside, and the bright water behind it bends and magnifies as if seen through a lens. Where the beams pass through the sphere they break into a trembling web of light ripples across the sand beneath. Three plump orange goldfish with trailing veil tails glide past on the left, a pair of yellow-and-black banded reef fish dart across to the right, and from a pale coral at the bottom of the frame a thin chain of silver bubbles wobbles upward past the glass toward the sun. The whole scene is glossy, spotless and slightly too perfect, like a desktop aquarium on an early-2000s computer left running in a bright office: saturated aqua, cyan and pure white with warm orange accents, crisp high-definition detail, soft bloom on every highlight, no murk, no debris, no people, no text or lettering anywhere. Thanks.
